create.name: Rev. Dr. Hillary Raining
create.bio:
Hillary Raining is an Episcopal priest who is rector at St. Columba's, a large Episcopal parish in Washington, DC, and who brings yoga, meditation and time in nature into Christian spiritual practice. She traces her sense of vocation to her earliest childhood memory, studied at Yale and its Institute of Sacred Music, and earned a Doctorate in Ministry at Drew University with research on worship, preaching and reconciliation. She has taught at the General Theological Seminary, where she directed its doctoral ministry programme and its Center of Christian Spirituality, and has written on confession and on Christian yoga.

She is a registered yoga teacher working mainly in the Ashtanga style, a meditation teacher, a spiritual director and a certified forest therapy guide, and she also keeps bees. That last interest gave its name to The Hive, the online community she founded for progressive Christians, which offers monthly classes, guided meditations, yoga sessions, book groups and recorded courses on the mystics, scripture and contemplative practice. She preaches most Sundays in her parish, leads retreats and talks for churches and conferences, and has taught online for The Shift Network on practices drawn from the Christian mystics. She is also a Sault Ste. Marie Chippewa tribal member.

courses.title: The Hive Membership
courses.description: Monthly membership of the online community she founded, with new classes each month and a library of past courses, meditations, talks, yoga sessions and book discussions. A seven-day free trial is offered.

courses.title: Joy in Confession: Freedom in Forgiveness
courses.description: A six-part recorded workshop on forgiveness and reconciliation, read through scripture, church tradition and spiritual practice. Each session pairs a short meditation with a practice to try, and a booklet doubles as a journal.

courses.title: The Science of Hope and Joy
courses.description: A five-week course, now available as replays, built on Paul's letter to the Philippians. It sets that letter beside research on hope and joy and uses prayerful exercises to practise a more hopeful outlook.

free_resources.title: Free Yoga Class
free_resources.description: A free yoga class offered from her writings page in exchange for signing up to her mailing list.
